title: How women scavenge scraps from lithium to earn a living in Nigeria
html:
How women scavenge scraps from lithium to earn a living in Nigeria

Dozens of women sift through the waste left behind by lithium miners in Nigeria, digging for traces of ore to resell. Nigeria’s lithium industry is estimated to be worth over $34bn, but these workers only take home about $15 a week. In collaboration with Light Oriye Tamunotonye.
summary: Dozens of women sift through the waste left behind by lithium miners in Nigeria, digging for traces of ore to resell.
